project_context.theme: Light Theme (with High-Contrast Dark Navy elements)
project_context.role: Graphic Designer / Front-End Developer / Technical Support
project_context.vibe: Editorial, distinctive, opinionated, art-directed. Think bold display typography, asymmetric bento grid, generous whitespace, subtle animation, kinetic text.

usage_rules.background: Use background_light (#f8fafc) as the primary page background to keep contrast sharp against navy and cyan.
usage_rules.ctas: Use primary_cyan (#0093c9) strictly for primary actions, buttons, and selective hover states or kinetic typographic highlights.
usage_rules.footer_and_inverted_cards: Use deep_footer_navy (#004965) for the footer and dark_navy (#2c3e50) for inverted bento grid cards to create visual tension.

headings.description: Bold, neo-grotesque display font. Use font-black or font-light to create extreme weight contrast.

scale.h1_hero: text-5xl sm:text-7xl lg:text-[7vw] leading-none tracking-tighter font-black

rules.no_center: Avoid centering paragraph text. Left-align for strong editorial hierarchy.
rules.kinetic_hover: On links and project titles, implement a subtle kinetic/staggered character hover effect if possible, or a cyan underline slide-in.

layout_and_spacing.grid_system: Mode A: The 'Tetris' Bento Grid. Use for the Projects/Case Studies section.

bento_rules.container: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-8 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-6 lg:gap-8

layout_and_spacing.spacing: Generous spacing. Use py-24 or py-32 for section padding. Containers must have internal padding (p-8 to p-12) to prevent text collision.
layout_and_spacing.corners: Rounded-3xl for bento cards to balance the sharp typographic feel with modern 2026 aesthetics. Use 1px subtle borders (border-border).

navigation.style: Glassmorphism sticky header (backdrop-blur-xl bg-background_light/80) with 1px bottom border.
navigation.elements: Logo (CS monogram text or icon), Links (About, Experience, Projects, Skills), CTA (Resume Download - primary cyan button).

hero.structure: Massive text 'Clifford Santos'. Underneath, a staggered grid showing a short bio and an abstract design element or headshot placeholder. Do not center everything.

about.structure: Split layout. Left: Large kinetic typography or statement. Right: Headshot (rounded-2xl) paired with a structured, multi-paragraph bio. Include subtle background noise/grain texture in this section.

experience.structure: Left-aligned company names (h3) and dates (overline). Body text describing roles. Use a vertical 1px line (border-l) to connect them visually. Companies: Bridge View Strategies (2016-2026), Lokeel, Custom Virtual Solutions, BCWebLab.

projects.structure: 12 projects (Jenny Gausto Logo, Bakers Roofing, etc.). Mix images with text-only cards. Some cards inverted (Dark Navy bg, White text) for contrast. Images must fill the card space and scale on hover.

skills.structure: Group by category (Design, Dev, Marketing, AI). Use hollow pills (border border-navy text-navy) and solid pills for emphasis.

contact.structure: Use Shadcn Form, Input, Textarea. Strip default borders and use bottom-border only (underlined inputs) for an editorial feel, or heavily rounded minimalist inputs. Button: Dark Navy background, Cyan hover.

footer.structure: Deep footer navy background (#004965). Huge 'Let's Talk' text (text-[10vw]). Social links (FB, Twitter, LinkedIn, DeviantArt). Cyan accents.

motion_and_interaction.scroll: MANDATORY: Implement Lenis smooth scroll for a premium feel.
motion_and_interaction.page_load: Framer Motion staggered text reveals for the Hero section.
motion_and_interaction.hover_states: Images inside bento cards MUST have group-hover:scale-105 transition-transform duration-700 ease-out. Text colors must shift to cyan on interactive elements.
motion_and_interaction.cursor: Implement a custom subtle dot cursor that expands on interactive elements (optional but recommended for creative portfolios).

media_assets.instructions_to_main_agent: Use these images randomly to populate the 12 project bento cards. Do not use placehold.it or via.placeholder.com. Use phosphor-icons for all UI iconography.

testing_requirements.attributes: Add data-testid attributes to all interactive elements (links, buttons, form inputs, bento cards). e.g., data-testid='hero-contact-button'.
